title: Awesome!
text: The Riding activity was the most beautiful activity we did on our entire journey. So glad we made this choice! It was a wonderful morning and our guide Marta was lovely, the landscape beautiful, and most important: the horses absolutely well trained! We are not experienced and we totally relaxed on those large horses backs - after the initial short training session and the first few minutes on the calm and friendly horses. Thank you for this wonderful experience!
author: Anne_V

title: Amazing horse riding experience
text:
Everything about this experience was 10/10. 
The communication from start to finish was great. Dani was an excellent tutor and catered for all abilities matching the horses to the rider.  My husband has not ridden before and he felt totally at ease. Dani’s Andalusian horses are beautifully trained and so well looked after and everything I imagined.  We were given time in the sand school to feel comfortable on the horses before heading out. 
Riding in the countryside was beautiful and Dani was very knowledgable about the area. Also gave some fab recommendations on where to eat the most amazing
author: Vanessa_T

title: Highly recommended
text: Beautiful horses and countryside. Our guide was lovely and informative
author: rebeccacL3878LW

title: Great and unique experience
text: Picked us up at our hotel. Very friendly and  personable. Highly recommend. Horses were very friendly as well, and safe to ride. Danny had many great stories to tell us.
author: Lori T

title: Great ride through the countryside
text: This was an awesome ride! Daniel, our host, contacted me prior to my ride requesting my experience level and examples of my riding experience. I am a Western Pleasure rider from the U.S. who rides each week.  Daniel chose the most beautiful Dressage horse for me. When we arrived at the barn we took the horses to the arena and Daniel demonstrated how to ride (hand placement, rein length, posture, and leg pressure). author: Dlb725

title: Highly recommend!!! Fun and unique experience.
text: Cannot recommend this experience enough! Danny was a fantastic host and guide.  He was very patient with our 10 and 12 year olds.   They were instantly put at ease to enjoy the ride.  It was our favorite activity in Spain.  We would 100% do this again.
author: Jennifer_P

title: Jolly good fun. Martha...
text: Jolly good fun. Martha was a great guide. Horses had good temperament. The trails and fields we walked through were beautiful.

title: Riding through olive fields
text: Our coach Marta was really friendly, nice and patient.  The overall experience was amazing, would highly recommend!
author: Mila_V

title: Fantastic tour
text: Lovely experience. Fantastic, relaxed tour guide. Was very kind as we had no horse riding experience. Beautiful scenery. Our favourite thing we've done whilst in Seville. Can't recommend highly enough.
